✦ AI IN CONTEXT

a-eye clearance integrated packaging lines

AI-enabled inspection

Marchesini integrates SEA Vision’s a-eye clearance technology into pharmaceutical packaging lines. AI camera analysis helps identify items left from a previous batch, supporting more efficient changeovers and a documented clearance process.
